sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是 Benjamin Poulin，我是 Mark Ronson，欢迎收听《重构者》(The Reframers)，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我那个黑胶唱片时代的夜店打碟的日子里，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着 300 件最珍贵的藏品去工作，把 DJ 台变成一个充满 50 年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼 (Audemars Piguet) 出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的 Michael Barbaro。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》(The Daily)。

sentences.en: Today, as expected, the president's former campaign chairman, Paul Manafort, has been indicted.
sentences.zh: 今天，正如预期的那样，总统的前竞选主席保罗·马纳福特 (Paul Manafort) 已被起诉。

sentences.en: The first indictment in special counsel Robert Mueller's Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 这是特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒 (Robert Mueller) 俄罗斯调查案中的首份起诉书。

sentences.en: But another surprise indictment may tell a more meaningful story about what the Trump campaign knew about Russian interference in the election and when it knew it.
sentences.zh: 但另一份出人意料的起诉书可能揭示了一个更具深意的故事，关于特朗普竞选团队对俄罗斯干预选举的知情程度及其时间点。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, October 31St.
sentences.zh: 今天是 10 月 31 日，星期二。

sentences.en: Mattapuzo, tell me about George Papadopoulos.
sentences.zh: Matt，跟我说说乔治·帕帕多普洛斯 (George Papadopoulos) 这个人。

sentences.en: Who is this guy before he comes into contact with the Trump team?
sentences.zh: 在接触特朗普团队之前，他是个什么样的人？

sentences.en: He was a research fellow at the Hudson Institute, which is a conservative think tank in town.
sentences.zh: 他当时是哈德逊研究所 (Hudson Institute) 的研究员，那是城里的一家保守派智库。

sentences.en: He was not a well-established foreign policy expert in Washington by any stretch.
sentences.zh: 无论怎么看，他都不是华盛顿资深的外交政策专家。

sentences.en: I mean, he was 30 years old when he joined the campaign.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他加入竞选团队时才 30 岁。

sentences.en: And, you know, in a city where you have a ton of think tanks and a ton of experts, he wasn't somebody who stood out.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在这个智库和专家扎堆的城市里，他并不是什么出类拔萃的人物。

sentences.en: And what does Papadopoulos understand to be his role and mission on the Trump team when he comes on board as a foreign policy advisor in early 2016?
sentences.zh: 那么，当帕帕多普洛斯在 2016 年初作为外交政策顾问加入特朗普团队时，他认为自己的角色和使命是什么？

sentences.en: Well, we now know that he was told one of the key foreign policy areas of the Trump campaign was going to be an improved relationship with Russia.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们现在知道，有人告诉他，特朗普竞选团队外交政策的关键领域之一将是改善与俄罗斯的关系。

sentences.en: If we can get along with Russia, that's very good.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能与俄罗斯和睦相处，那是非常好的。

sentences.en: If Russia wants to spend millions of dollars a day dropping bombs on ISIS, I'm OK with that.
sentences.zh: 如果俄罗斯想每天花几百万美元去轰炸 ISIS，我没意见。

sentences.en: You know, I'm OK with that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我没意见。

sentences.en: And so that is something that I think he then set out to try to focus on, make himself a little more valuable to the campaign by focusing on Russia.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，他当时就是着手专注于这一点，通过关注俄罗斯来让自己对竞选团队更有价值。

sentences.en: OK, so with that in mind, what happens?
sentences.zh: 好的，带着这个目标，后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: We know he went to Italy and he meets this professor who is a professor of diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他去了意大利，遇见了一位外交学教授。

sentences.en: And when he tells him, oh, I'm going to, by the way, I'm going to be named a foreign policy advisor to Donald Trump, this professor takes real interest in him.
sentences.zh: 当他告诉对方，顺便说一下，我即将被任命为唐纳德·特朗普的外交政策顾问时，这位教授对他产生了浓厚的兴趣。

sentences.en: And the professor says, well, he has really close ties with the Russian government.
sentences.zh: 教授说，他和俄罗斯政府有非常密切的联系。

sentences.en: And Papadopoulos says, well, that's good for me because if Russia is going to be a focus of the campaign, then having that relationship can only be helpful.
sentences.zh: 帕帕多普洛斯说，那对我来说是好事，因为如果俄罗斯是竞选的重点，那么建立这种关系只会是有益的。

sentences.en: So they sort of strike up a conversation, they meet in London, and it's at that meeting where the professor says, you know,
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始交谈，并在伦敦会面，正是在那次会面上，教授说，你知道，

sentences.en: the Russians have dirt on Hillary Clinton and says they have thousands of Clinton emails and that this could be obviously damaging to Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人有希拉里·克林顿的黑料，他们有数千封克林顿的邮件，这显然会对希拉里·克林顿造成损害。

sentences.en: So, Matt, the Russian government potentially is reaching out via this professor.
sentences.zh: 所以，Matt，俄罗斯政府可能正通过这位教授进行接触。

sentences.en: Why would the Russian government seem to go through him?
sentences.zh: 为什么俄罗斯政府似乎要通过他来传话？

sentences.en: The thing to know here is that an FBI agent filed an affidavit that says,
sentences.zh: 这里需要了解的是，一名联邦调查局 (FBI) 特工提交了一份宣誓书，其中写道：

sentences.en: the Russian government and its intelligence and security services frequently make the use of non-governmental intermediaries to achieve their foreign intelligence objectives.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯政府及其情报和安全部门经常利用非政府中间人来实现其外国情报目标。

sentences.en: I'm aware the Russian government uses individuals associated with academia and think tanks in such capacity.
sentences.zh: 我知道俄罗斯政府利用与学术界和智库相关的人员来担任这种角色。

sentences.en: As far as the FBI is concerned, this is par for the course.
sentences.zh: 在 FBI 看来，这已是司空见惯的事。

sentences.en: If the Russian government wants to reach out to you, they don't pick up the phone and say, hi, I'm Vlad, we've got emails, they use a cutout.
sentences.zh: 如果俄罗斯政府想联系你，他们不会直接打电话说‘嗨，我是弗拉基米尔，我们有邮件’，他们会使用中间人。

sentences.en: So somewhat by chance, somewhat by perhaps the intention of the Russian government, this young new member of the Trump campaign, George Papadopoulos,
sentences.zh: 所以，某种程度上是偶然，某种程度上或许是俄罗斯政府的刻意为之，这位特朗普竞选团队年轻的新成员乔治·帕帕多普洛斯，

sentences.en: comes into contact with possibly an agent of the Russian government making some kind of an offer.
sentences.zh: 接触到了可能是俄罗斯政府代理人的人，并收到某种提议。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Matt, let's talk about the emails.
sentences.zh: Matt，我们来谈谈那些邮件。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about the timing of where we are in the campaign.
sentences.zh: 我在考虑竞选进程的时间点。

sentences.en: It's April, and this 30-year-old advisor has just been told about thousands of emails about Hillary Clinton that the Russian government has.
sentences.zh: 那是四月，这位 30 岁的顾问刚刚被告知俄罗斯政府掌握了数千封关于希拉里·克林顿的邮件。

sentences.en: Do we know if these are the emails that were hacked by the Russians?
sentences.zh: 我们知道这些就是被俄罗斯人黑掉的那些邮件吗？

sentences.en: So we don't know if they're the emails, the DNC hacked emails, but it follows chronologically that they would be, right?
sentences.zh: 我们不知道它们是否就是那些被黑的民主党全国委员会 (DNC) 邮件，但从时间顺序上看应该是的，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, we know that in March, the Russians hacked John Podesta's emails.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们知道三月份俄罗斯人黑了约翰·波德斯塔 (John Podesta) 的邮件。

sentences.en: This is Hillary Clinton's campaign chairman.
sentences.zh: 那是希拉里·克林顿的竞选主席。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This then would be shortly thereafter that somebody's saying we have thousands of emails.
sentences.zh: 那之后不久就有人说我们有数千封邮件。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Just a month after.
sentences.zh: 就在一个月后。

sentences.en: Kind of remarkable.
sentences.zh: 相当引人注目。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Campaign 2016, day one of the Democratic National Convention is being overshadowed by the DNC email scandal.
sentences.zh: 2016 年竞选期间，民主党全国代表大会的第一天被 DNC 邮件丑闻蒙上了阴影。

sentences.en: So it's going to be another couple months before the rest of the world learns that emails have been hacked from the accounts of Podesta and the Democratic National Committee.
sentences.zh: 所以还要过几个月，全世界才会知道波德斯塔和民主党全国委员会的账户邮件被黑了。

sentences.en: This morning, the FBI confirmed it's now investigating how thousands of emails were hacked.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，FBI 证实正在调查数千封邮件是如何被黑的。

sentences.en: Officials suspect it came from a Russian cyber attack.
sentences.zh: 官员们怀疑这来自俄罗斯的网络攻击。

sentences.en: If these are the same emails, is this the first time that we know of that someone may have been informed of these stolen emails?
sentences.zh: 如果这些是同一批邮件，这是我们所知的第一次有人可能被告知这些被盗邮件吗？

sentences.en: It's certainly the earliest established moment where somebody inside the Trump campaign is told Russia has emails on Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 这无疑是目前确定的最早时间点，即特朗普竞选团队内部有人被告知俄罗斯掌握了希拉里·克林顿的邮件。

sentences.en: And that's important because...
sentences.zh: 这很重要，因为……

sentences.en: Did anyone involved in the Trump campaign have any contact with Russians trying to meddle with the election?
sentences.zh: 特朗普竞选团队中有人与试图干预选举的俄罗斯人有过接触吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有。

sentences.en: And I discussed that with the president-elect just last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚刚和当选总统讨论过这个问题。

sentences.en: Those conversations never happened.
sentences.zh: 那些对话从未发生过。

sentences.en: In addition to saying we never had any connections or any dealings with Russia, we never met with any Russians,
sentences.zh: 除了说我们从未与俄罗斯有任何联系或交易，我们从未见过任何俄罗斯人之外，

sentences.en: the Trump campaign has also said we weren't in on it, we didn't know about the Russian hacking campaign.
sentences.zh: 特朗普竞选团队还表示，我们没有参与其中，我们不知道俄罗斯的黑客行动。

sentences.en: I hear people saying it like it's a fact on television that is just not only inaccurate and false, but it's dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我听到电视上有人说得好像这是事实一样，这不仅不准确、虚假，而且很危险。

sentences.en: And this suggests what you're telling me, the possibility that, in fact, they did.
sentences.zh: 而这暗示了你告诉我的情况，即事实上他们确实参与了的可能性。

sentences.en: At this point, what we know is that this person in the campaign was told that Russia had thousands of Clinton emails.
sentences.zh: 目前我们所知的是，竞选团队中的这个人被告知俄罗斯掌握了数千封克林顿的邮件。

sentences.en: We don't know if anybody else was told.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道是否还有其他人被告知。

sentences.en: We don't know if Papadopoulos then turns around and goes up and tells senior people in the campaign.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道帕帕多普洛斯后来是否转身去告诉了竞选团队的高层。

sentences.en: And that's going to be important.
sentences.zh: 而这一点将会很重要。

sentences.en: I mean, that is an important thing to know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一件很重要的事情。

sentences.en: If you're Bob Mueller at the special counsel, you want to establish who, if anybody else, knew.
sentences.zh: 如果你是特别检察官鲍勃·穆勒 (Bob Mueller)，你会想确定还有谁（如果有的话）知道这件事。

sentences.en: Matt, why don't we know that?
sentences.zh: Matt，为什么我们不知道这一点？

sentences.en: We're seeing all kinds of emails from Papadopoulos to more senior figures on the Trump team.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了帕帕多普洛斯发给特朗普团队更高级别人物的各种邮件。

sentences.en: So why don't we know if he passed on this information within the campaign?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么我们不知道他是否在竞选团队内部传递了这些信息？

sentences.en: Well, there's two options.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有两种可能。

sentences.en: The first option is he didn't.
sentences.zh: 第一种可能是他没说。

sentences.en: The second option is he told somebody,
sentences.zh: 第二种可能是他告诉了某人，

sentences.en: and there's no reason to put that out there right now because that's information you want to try to corroborate elsewhere or you want to try to build into another case.
sentences.zh: 而且现在没有理由把这些公开，因为那是你想在其他地方设法证实，或者想将其构建到另一个案件中的信息。

sentences.en: You know, right now, all we know is there's no reference to him telling senior people about the emails.
sentences.zh: 你知道，目前我们所知道的只是没有提到他告诉高层关于邮件的事。

sentences.en: So the FEI may have more information about this than we're learning on Monday.
sentences.zh: 所以 FBI 可能比我们在周一了解到的掌握了更多信息。

sentences.en: Well, they definitely have more information than we're learning today,
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们肯定比我们今天了解到的掌握了更多信息，

sentences.en: but I don't know if they have more information about the point of whether he shared the email issue with other people.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道他们是否掌握了关于他是否与其他人分享了邮件问题的更多信息。

sentences.en: Do we know if Papadopoulos understands the significance of the information that he's in possession of about the emails?
sentences.zh: 我们知道帕帕多普洛斯是否理解他所掌握的关于邮件的信息的重要性吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a great question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是个好问题。

sentences.en: In the moment, maybe he doesn't.
sentences.zh: 当时，也许他并不理解。

sentences.en: On the Democratic side, Hillary Clinton is dealing with the latest round of leaked emails from WikiLeaks.
sentences.zh: 在民主党方面，希拉里·克林顿正在处理维基解密 (WikiLeaks) 最新一轮泄露的邮件。

sentences.en: The news ultimately comes out that her emails are getting leaked.
sentences.zh: 最终消息传出，她的邮件被泄露了。

sentences.en: The Clinton campaign has not verified or disputed the authenticity of any specific files in the leak, but they blame Russia for the breach.
sentences.zh: 克林顿竞选团队没有证实或否认泄露文件中任何特定文件的真实性，但他们指责俄罗斯实施了这次入侵。

sentences.en: And he certainly remembers that that conversation was had.
sentences.zh: 而且他肯定记得有过那次谈话。

sentences.en: As her emails become a central issue in the campaign, he knows the conversation was we've got thousands of her emails or they've got thousands of her emails.
sentences.zh: 随着她的邮件成为竞选的核心议题，他知道当时的对话是‘我们有她数千封邮件’或者‘他们有她数千封邮件’。

sentences.en: So maybe he doesn't know the significance when it gets said.
sentences.zh: 所以也许在被告知时他并不了解其重要性。

sentences.en: But at some point, of course, he has to understand the significance of what he's been told.
sentences.zh: 但在某个时刻，他当然必须明白他被告知的内容的重要性。

sentences.en: So what do we know about what Papadopoulos conveys back to the Trump team about all this?
sentences.zh: 那么我们知道帕帕多普洛斯向特朗普团队传达了关于这一切的什么信息？

sentences.en: How does he represent these interactions with the professor?
sentences.zh: 他是如何描述这些与教授的互动的？

sentences.en: What we know is the offer as conveyed by Papadopoulos back to the campaign is,
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，帕帕多普洛斯传达回竞选团队的提议是：

sentences.en: I've got a guy who can set up a high-level meeting between Donald Trump or others and top people in Russia.
sentences.zh: 我有一个人可以安排唐纳德·特朗普或其他人和俄罗斯高层进行高级别会晤。

sentences.en: And if looked at through the lens of Papadopoulos trying to, you know, establish his bona fides in the campaign, you know, this is a, hey, look at it, I'm important.
sentences.zh: 如果通过帕帕多普洛斯试图在竞选团队中建立自己信誉的视角来看，这就像是‘嘿，看，我很重要’。

sentences.en: You know, he refers to, oh, this is my friend, the professor.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他提到‘哦，这是我的朋友，那位教授’。

sentences.en: You know, it can be read as him trying to prove for the campaign that he's got juice with Russia.
sentences.zh: 这可以被解读为他试图向竞选团队证明他在俄罗斯有门路。

sentences.en: Matt, how does Papadopoulos' supervisor respond to this information that he presents?
sentences.zh: Matt，帕帕多普洛斯的上司对这些他提供的信息有何反应？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, first off, he's like, great work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，首先，他说，干得好。

sentences.en: That was the quote, great work.
sentences.zh: 原话就是‘干得好’。

sentences.en: But, you know, we've got to run this through the campaign.
sentences.zh: 但是，我们必须通过竞选团队来处理这件事。

sentences.en: Let's not make any commitments to what the candidate's going to do when the information bubbled up to the top levels of the campaign.
sentences.zh: 当信息传达到竞选团队高层时，不要对候选人要做的事情做出任何承诺。

sentences.en: You know, they actually end up throwing the brakes on.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们最终实际上踩了刹车。

sentences.en: And they say, look, DT, Donald Trump, is not doing these trips.
sentences.zh: 他们说，看，DT（唐纳德·特朗普）不会去进行这些访问。

sentences.en: It should be someone low-level in the campaign so as not to send any signal.
sentences.zh: 应该是竞选团队中级别较低的人去，以免发出任何信号。

sentences.en: They don't say nobody's going to go meet with Russians.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有说没有人会去见俄罗斯人。

sentences.en: But they're like, well, it's not going to be Donald Trump, although that meeting ultimately does not happen.
sentences.zh: 但他们觉得，嗯，那不会是唐纳德·特朗普，尽管那次会面最终并没有发生。

sentences.en: So what's the crime here?
sentences.zh: 那么这里的罪行是什么？

sentences.en: When does Papadopoulos commit an actual crime?
sentences.zh: 帕帕多普洛斯是什么时候犯下实际罪行的？

sentences.en: Well, so you have to fast forward through the general election, through the transition, through the inauguration.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你得跳过大选、过渡期和就职典礼。

sentences.en: And it's six days after Inauguration Day, January 27th, 2017.
sentences.zh: 那是就职典礼六天后，2017 年 1 月 27 日。

sentences.en: And the FBI visits George Papadopoulos.
sentences.zh: FBI 拜访了乔治·帕帕多普洛斯。

sentences.en: And the FBI is now in the thick of an investigation into Russian meddling in the election and whether anybody in the Trump campaign was in on it.
sentences.zh: 当时 FBI 正深入调查俄罗斯干预选举，以及特朗普竞选团队中是否有人参与其中。

sentences.en: And they show up and they say to Papadopoulos, hey, can we talk about your relationship with this professor?
sentences.zh: 他们出现并对帕帕多普洛斯说，嘿，我们能谈谈你和那位教授的关系吗？

sentences.en: He's like, oh, yeah, but that guy was like nothing.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，是的，但那个人没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: He just talked a good game.
sentences.zh: 他只是夸夸其谈。

sentences.en: And that had really nothing to do with the campaign.
sentences.zh: 那和竞选活动真的没什么关系。

sentences.en: That's a relationship I had beforehand.
sentences.zh: 那是我之前就有的关系。

sentences.en: And it was nothing serious.
sentences.zh: 而且没什么严肃的。

sentences.en: And of course, you know, at this point, either the FBI knows he's lying or suspects he's lying.
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道，此时此刻，FBI 要么知道他在撒谎，要么怀疑他在撒谎。

sentences.en: And that's the crime.
sentences.zh: 而这就是罪行。

sentences.en: Lying to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 对 FBI 撒谎。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Matt, why do we think that Papadopoulos lied to the FBI?
sentences.zh: Matt，为什么我们认为帕帕多普洛斯对 FBI 撒了谎？

sentences.en: I don't know why anybody lies to the FBI because it's always the lie that gets you.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么有人会对 FBI 撒谎，因为谎言总是会让你栽跟头。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's always the lie that gets you.
sentences.zh: 是的，谎言总是会让你栽跟头。

sentences.en: And Matt, something else meaningful happens the day of that first meeting when the FBI first visited Papadopoulos.
sentences.zh: Matt，在 FBI 第一次拜访帕帕多普洛斯的那天，还发生了另一件有意义的事。

sentences.en: What else happened on January 27th?
sentences.zh: 1 月 27 日还发生了什么？

sentences.en: So January 27th becomes an important day because that evening, Donald Trump unexpectedly calls Jim Comey, the FBI director at the time, to the White House for dinner.
sentences.zh: 1 月 27 日变得很重要，因为那天晚上，唐纳德·特朗普出人意料地打电话给当时的 FBI 局长吉姆·科米 (Jim Comey)，邀请他去白宫共进晚餐。

sentences.en: And in that meeting, that's the dinner where he says, I need your loyalty.
sentences.zh: 在那次会面上，就是在那顿晚餐上，他说，我需要你的忠诚。

sentences.en: And so if you're Jim Comey, right, you have to know that your agents just went out and interviewed Papadopoulos.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是吉姆·科米，你肯定知道你的特工刚刚去采访了帕帕多普洛斯。

sentences.en: So the very moment that Donald Trump is saying to his FBI director, I need your loyalty, the FBI director,
sentences.zh: 所以就在唐纳德·特朗普对他的 FBI 局长说‘我需要你的忠诚’的那一刻，FBI 局长，

sentences.en: his agents are out there talking to Donald Trump's campaign advisor about his meetings with Russians and how much he knew about the email hacking and Russian influence.
sentences.zh: 他的特工们正在外面和唐纳德·特朗普的竞选顾问谈论他与俄罗斯人的会面，以及他对邮件黑客事件和俄罗斯影响的了解程度。

sentences.en: So it just makes that meeting that much more fraught.
sentences.zh: 这让那次会面变得更加紧张。

sentences.en: You can imagine, you know, it helps explain why Comey said that made him feel so uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，这有助于解释为什么科米说那让他感到非常不舒服。

sentences.en: I tried to hold the line, hold the line.
sentences.zh: 我试图坚持立场，坚持立场。

sentences.en: It got very awkward.
sentences.zh: 气氛变得非常尴尬。

sentences.en: And I then said, you'll always have honesty from me.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，你总会得到我的诚实。

sentences.en: He said, honest loyalty.
sentences.zh: 他说，诚实的忠诚。

sentences.en: And then I acceded to that as a way to end this awkwardness.
sentences.zh: 然后我答应了这一点，作为结束这种尴尬的一种方式。

sentences.en: At the culmination of all these events, you're summarily fired without any explanation or anything else.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些事件的高潮，你被草率解雇了，没有任何解释或其他任何东西。

sentences.en: Well, there was an explanation.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一个解释。

sentences.en: I just don't buy it.
sentences.zh: 我只是不相信。

sentences.en: Well.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So does the Papadopoulos saga potentially tell us more about the Russian government and its strategies and its outreach more than it does about the Trump team?
sentences.zh: 那么，帕帕多普洛斯的故事是否比特朗普团队更能告诉我们关于俄罗斯政府及其战略和外联的信息？

sentences.en: Because they reach out to this young man.
sentences.zh: 因为他们接触了这个年轻人。

sentences.en: It doesn't really go anywhere.
sentences.zh: 这其实没什么实质进展。

sentences.en: A couple of months later, there's another attempt with a more significant figure, Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，又出现了一次尝试，这次涉及到一个更重要的人物，小唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: The explosive news about President Trump and Russia, it involves Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 关于特朗普总统和俄罗斯的爆炸性新闻，涉及到了小唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: breaking in the last 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 在过去30分钟内刚刚爆出。

sentences.en: The New York Times reporting that Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，小特朗普

sentences.en: met with a Russian lawyer last year during the campaign after being promised damaging information on Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 去年竞选期间在得到可以获得希拉里·克林顿负面信息的承诺后，与一名俄罗斯律师见了面。

sentences.en: Well, so it's not unusual for a foreign government to try to make contacts in a campaign.
sentences.zh: 嗯，外国政府试图在竞选中建立联系并不罕见。

sentences.en: That part's not unusual.
sentences.zh: 那部分并不罕见。

sentences.en: It's unusual that a—I mean, I won't call Russia an adversary, but a country that has a strained relationship with the United States would reach out to one candidate and say,
sentences.zh: 罕见的是——我的意思是，我不会称俄罗斯为对手，但一个与美国关系紧张的国家会主动接触某位候选人并说，

sentences.en: we can help you and we can directly harm your competitor.
sentences.zh: 我们可以帮你，我们可以直接伤害你的竞争对手。

sentences.en: That's what's unique about this.
sentences.zh: 这就是这件事独特的地方。

sentences.en: And that now is starting to come into focus for us.
sentences.zh: 而这一点现在开始在我们面前变得清晰起来。

sentences.en: Either people around Donald Trump don't understand that they're being targeted as part of an influence campaign or they're witting in doing this.
sentences.zh: 要么是唐纳德·特朗普身边的人不明白他们正成为影响力行动的目标，要么就是他们明知故犯。

sentences.en: And so kind of the picture of the 2016 election is still coming into focus for us.
sentences.zh: 所以，2016年大选的图景对我们来说仍然在逐渐清晰。

sentences.en: So at this point, it's really clear that the Russians really wanted to make contact with the Trump campaign and really make Trump president.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，很明显俄罗斯人确实想与特朗普竞选团队建立联系，并确实想让特朗普当选总统。

sentences.en: The big question is, what did the Trump team do with that outreach?
sentences.zh: 最大的问题是，特朗普团队是如何处理这种接触的？

sentences.en: To me, this is the most explicit evidence that we have to date, that the Russian government was reaching into the Trump campaign and saying, hey, we got emails.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是我们迄今为止得到的最明确的证据，表明俄罗斯政府正在伸向特朗普竞选团队并说，嘿，我们有邮件。

sentences.en: Hey, we want to help you.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我们想帮你。

sentences.en: And as we heard with the June 2016 meeting at Trump Tower, the response from people in the Trump campaign is, sounds great.
sentences.zh: 正如我们听到的关于2016年6月特朗普大厦那次会议的情况，特朗普竞选团队人员的回应是，听起来不错。

sentences.en: That sounds fantastic.
sentences.zh: 那听起来太棒了。

sentences.en: So when you hear the president say, no collusion, or type it on Twitter in all caps, no collusion, I guess the best interpretation, the most honest interpretation of this now is,
sentences.zh: 所以当你听到总统说“没有勾结”，或者在推特上用全大写字母打出“没有勾结”时，我想现在对这件事最好的解读，最诚实的解读是，

sentences.en: no collusion that meant anything.
sentences.zh: 没有那种有实质意义的勾结。

sentences.en: But it's becoming really hard to just say no collusion and leave it at that.
sentences.zh: 但现在要仅仅说“没有勾结”并就此打住，变得非常困难。

sentences.en: But it's increasingly seeming like Russia wants collusion, is maybe repeatedly offering collusion.
sentences.zh: 但越来越像是俄罗斯想要勾结，甚至可能是在反复提议勾结。

sentences.en: And it's not quite clear yet whether the Trump campaign was capable of collusion or ever participated in collusion.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚特朗普竞选团队是否有能力勾结，或者是否真的参与了勾结。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, they took meetings and lied about it, not just to the public, but to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们参加了会议并对此撒了谎，不仅是对公众，而且是对联邦调查局。

sentences.en: And, you know, we're still concealing the nature of those meetings in July when, you know, my colleagues and I approached them about the Trump Tower meeting and said,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当我和我的同事在七月份就特朗普大厦会议接触他们并询问时，他们仍然在隐瞒那些会议的性质，并说，

sentences.en: what was that about?
sentences.zh: 那是什么事？

sentences.en: And they're like, ah, that's just restaurant adoption.
sentences.zh: 他们说，啊，那只是关于领养孩子的事。

sentences.en: They were meeting with these people on a promise of help and then lying about it.
sentences.zh: 他们与这些人会面，承诺获得帮助，然后对此撒谎。

sentences.en: We don't have any evidence that the Trump team got emails from this professor or from the lawyer who went to Trump Tower.
sentences.zh: 我们没有任何证据表明特朗普团队从这位教授或去特朗普大厦的律师那里收到了邮件。

sentences.en: We don't have any evidence of that.
sentences.zh: 我们没有这方面的证据。

sentences.en: And the Trump team has repeatedly said, nothing happened, nothing happened, nothing happened.
sentences.zh: 特朗普团队反复说，什么都没发生，什么都没发生，什么都没发生。

sentences.en: And we don't have a reason to disbelieve them, except that they've also repeatedly said, we didn't meet with any Russians.
sentences.zh: 我们没有理由不相信他们，除了他们也反复说过，我们没有见过任何俄罗斯人。

sentences.en: And when people were asked about it directly, they lied about it.
sentences.zh: 而当人们直接问起这件事时，他们撒了谎。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: On Monday morning, Donald Trump's former campaign chairman, Paul Manafort, along with his associate, Rick Gates,
sentences.zh: 周一上午，唐纳德·特朗普的前竞选主席保罗·马纳福特，连同他的合伙人里克·盖茨，

sentences.en: was also indicted as part of the Mueller investigation on charges that he funneled millions of dollars through overseas shell companies and used that money to buy luxury cars,
sentences.zh: 也作为穆勒调查的一部分被起诉，罪名是他通过海外空壳公司转移了数百万美元，并用这些钱购买了豪华汽车、

sentences.en: real estate, antiques and expensive suits.
sentences.zh: 房地产、古董和昂贵的西装。

sentences.en: The indictment does not draw any connection between the charges and the Trump campaign's ties to Russia,
sentences.zh: 起诉书没有在这些指控与特朗普竞选团队和俄罗斯的关系之间画上任何联系，

sentences.en: suggesting that Mueller is taking an expansive view of his investigation and may be using these charges to get information from Manafort that more directly relates to the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 这表明穆勒正在对他的调查采取广泛的视角，并可能利用这些指控从马纳福特那里获取与俄罗斯调查更直接相关的信息。

sentences.en: On Monday afternoon, Manafort and Gates pled not guilty in federal district court.
sentences.zh: 周一下午，马纳福特和盖茨在联邦地方法院表示不认罪。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilron Mondani and many others live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔隆·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日在NYTimes.com上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Facebook has told congressional investigators that content posted by Russian agents seeking to meddle in last year's election reached 126 million of its users.
sentences.zh: Facebook告诉国会调查人员，俄罗斯特工为干预去年大选而发布的内容触及了其1.26亿用户。

sentences.en: Google has told the same investigators that Russian agents uploaded 1,000 videos to its YouTube service.
sentences.zh: 谷歌告诉同一批调查人员，俄罗斯特工向其YouTube服务上传了1000个视频。

sentences.en: And a federal judge is temporarily blocking President Trump from imposing a ban on transgender people in the military next year, ruling that the policy, quote,
sentences.zh: 一位联邦法官暂时阻止了特朗普总统明年对跨性别者实施禁令，裁定该政策，引用：

sentences.en: does not appear to be supported by any facts.
sentences.zh: “似乎没有任何事实支持”。

sentences.en: Instead, the judge said, it is motivated by a desire to express disapproval of transgender people generally.
sentences.zh: 相反，法官说，这是出于表达对跨性别者普遍不满的愿望。

sentences.en: Trump first announced the ban this summer in a series of surprise tweets, arguing that transgender people are disruptive and costly to the military.
sentences.zh: 特朗普今年夏天在一系列突如其来的推文中首次宣布了这项禁令，辩称跨性别者对军队具有破坏性且成本高昂。

sentences.en: On Monday, the judge in the case found there is no evidence to support either of those claiMs.
sentences.zh: 周一，该案法官发现没有证据支持这些说法中的任何一个。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一件非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方找到《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: They're coffee клиpenter.
sentences.zh: 他们是咖啡饮用者。

sentences.en: Let's see.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看。
